paper_metadata.title: Property Responses in Nb-Si-Hf-Ti-Al-W-B-Cr Alloys for High-Temperature Applications

evidence.quote: Multi-component Nb-(11,15)Si-5Hf-30Ti-4Al-4W-2B-(8 ,16)Cr alloys have been proposed, attempting to obtain the Nb-Si based allo ys with a comprehensive property.
It is clear that Si and Cr play a strengthening role for the Nb-Si based alloys.
Four alloys with compositions of Nb-(11,15)Si-5Hf-30Ti-4Al-4W-2B-(8,16)Cr were prepared, they were named 11Si-8Cr, 11Si-16Cr, 15Si-8Cr and 15Si-16Cr alloys hereafter.
